loop: Loop 08 — Desktop Workflow Integrity & Review UX

scenarios.name: Cold App Launch & Engine Startup Handshake
scenarios.precondition: Desktop app launched, sidecar spawned over stdio
scenarios.action: Invoke 'health' RPC and verify engine readiness before window display
scenarios.expected_outcome: Protocol 1, engine 0.1.0, healthy status, English OCR verified
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Handshake completes in ~1.2s; engine verified healthy

scenarios.name: Document Staging & Magic Byte Validation
scenarios.precondition: User selects files via native file picker
scenarios.action: Inspect magic bytes (%PDF-, PNG, JPEG) and enforce 50MB file size limit
scenarios.expected_outcome: Invalid formats or truncated files rejected before staging
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Tested with valid PDFs and corrupt byte streams; bad files rejected

scenarios.name: Staged Packet Workspace Creation & Path Traversal Guard
scenarios.action: Create packet in isolated docuready-workspaces/<packet_id>/ directory
scenarios.expected_outcome: Packet directory created; directory traversal attempts rejected
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Isolated workspace created; getDocumentContent blocks '..' and path separators

scenarios.name: Audit Execution & Real-Time Progress Streaming
scenarios.precondition: Staged packet exists in isolated workspace
scenarios.action: Trigger audit:start IPC; sidecar streams progress events over stdio
scenarios.expected_outcome: Progress percent (0-100%) streamed to renderer; audit completes with public result
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Progress streamed across intake, ocr, rules stages; completes with 100/100 score

scenarios.name: In-Flight Audit Cancellation & SIGTERM Recovery
scenarios.action: User clicks 'Cancel Audit'; IPC dispatches SIGTERM to child
scenarios.expected_outcome: In-flight job aborted immediately; sidecar respawns cleanly; status set to 'cancelled'
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Cancelled status returned without unhandled exceptions; workspace cleaned; subsequent health succeeds

scenarios.name: Double-Submission & Concurrency Guard
scenarios.action: User rapidly clicks 'Run Pre-Flight Audit' or hits Enter key repeatedly
scenarios.expected_outcome: Secondary click ignored by renderer and rejected by IPC; no duplicate sidecar tasks
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Guard prevents concurrent execution; existing running status returned

scenarios.name: Stale Result Invalidation on Document Selection Change
scenarios.precondition: Audit completed for packet A; user adds or removes files
scenarios.action: Select new documents via native picker
scenarios.expected_outcome: Prior audit result, score, and selected findings immediately invalidated
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: UI returns to 'idle'; prevents displaying stale audit results against altered document set

scenarios.name: Session Clear & OS Temporary Directory Data Purge
scenarios.precondition: Multiple staged packets and documents in temporary workspace
scenarios.action: User clicks 'Clear Session' or application initiates before-quit shutdown
scenarios.expected_outcome: All packet directories deleted from disk; document registry cleared; zero remnants
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: clearAll() recursively purges all workspace directories; verified on disk

scenarios.name: Human Review Explainability & Reason Code Guidance
scenarios.precondition: Audit contains REVIEW or MANUAL_REVIEW findings
scenarios.expected_outcome: Conservative abstention explained; specific reason code guidance rendered with actionable next steps
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Dedicated review callout renders with plain-language clerical explanation

scenarios.name: Evidence Provenance Auto-Focus & Page Synchronization
scenarios.precondition: Multi-document packet with findings on various pages
scenarios.expected_outcome: EvidenceViewer switches to corresponding document and page; highlights bounding box
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: handleSelectFinding selects activeDocumentId, sets targetPage, highlights bbox

scenarios.name: Unlocated Evidence & Missing Document Honest Representation
scenarios.precondition: Rule evaluates to MISSING or document absent
scenarios.action: Inspect finding in FindingPanel and EvidenceViewer
scenarios.expected_outcome: Zero invented coordinates (boundingBox: null); explicit 'Document Absent' callout
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: hasProvenance is false; honest empty state rendered with upload prompt

scenarios.name: Report Export Sanitization & PII Masking (JSON & Markdown)
scenarios.action: Export report via 'report:export' in Markdown or JSON format
scenarios.expected_outcome: Identifiers and names masked; statutory notice and disclaimer prominently included
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Exported reports verified; zero unmasked identifiers; disclaimer clearly embedded

scenarios.name: Full Keyboard Navigation & Visible Focus Outlines
scenarios.action: Tab through document list, finding cards, filter pills, and bounding boxes; activate with Enter/Space
scenarios.expected_outcome: All interactive elements focusable with 2px high-visibility outline; Enter/Space activates
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: Verified tabIndex={0}, role='button'/'tab', onKeyDown handlers, and CSS :focus-visible

scenarios.name: Non-Color Status Encoding Across Badges & Indicators
scenarios.precondition: User inspecting status badges under grayscale or color blindness
scenarios.action: Inspect finding cards and document indicators
scenarios.expected_outcome: Every status provides text + distinct icon: ❌ FAIL, 🚫 MISSING, ⚠️ WARN, 🔍 REVIEW, ✅ PASS
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: All badges and filter pills feature explicit icons and text alongside color

scenarios.name: Clean Application Shutdown & Resource Deallocation
scenarios.precondition: Application running with active sidecar process
scenarios.expected_outcome: Sidecar shutdown cleanly over JSON-RPC or SIGKILL; temporary files removed; process exits with code 0
scenarios.observed_outcome: PASS: before-quit handler awaits sidecar shutdown and workspace cleanup before quitting
